usage: Illustrative editorial website imagery; does not depict actual Wedeploy premises, staff or clients.
sharedPrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one individual website editorial hero photograph, landscape 4:3. Create a single realistic photograph, NOT a collage. [scene] Style: restrained contemporary Dutch business editorial photography, natural daylight, neutral warm grey and subtle navy palette, realistic diverse adults, comfortable negative space, uncomplicated composition, subjects near center so mobile crops retain them. Avoid artificial shiny skin, theatrical smiles, oversaturated colors, luxury, icons, overlays, text, letters, logos and watermarks. This is an illustrative website photo, not an actual company or identifiable real person.
